name: PLSC 3300
title: Principles of Turfgrass Irrigation Systems
description: Turfgrass irrigation systems, principles of hydraulics, irrigation components, design, installation and repair. Students will design irrigation systems for various turf areas. Field trips and fieldwork will be required. Taught with SAPL 230. Formerly offered as SPSS 3300.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to graduate students.
